# UX Checklist: Video Chat Room

**Purpose**: Lightweight author review of blocking UX/UI/a11y requirement gaps and conflicts in spec + plan before `/speckit-tasks`. Not an implementation or visual-QA test.
**Created**: 2026-09-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/realtime.md](../contracts/realtime.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK001 Is the visual-quality bar consistent: spec NFR-008 / PRD §6 (“works and is comprehensible”) versus the plan’s binding design system (shadcn, tokens, Inter, single accent)? [Conflict, Spec §NFR-008, Plan §Frontend UI]
- [ ] CHK002 Is chat/roster chrome specified as a PRD “panel/overlay” or as the plan’s always-visible secondary column at ≥1024px? [Conflict, Spec Constraints/PRD §6, Plan §Frontend UI]
- [ ] CHK003 Does “adaptive grid of 1–4 tiles” plus “own video shown separately as self-view” define whether self-view is inside the 1–4 grid or a fifth surface (PIP) when 2–4 people are present? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-043, Spec §NFR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are start-screen actions consistent: PRD §6 lists only «Создать комнату», while US-1 also names «Войти»? [Conflict, Spec §US-1, docs/prd.md §6]
- [ ] CHK005 Are meeting controls required to have visible labels (NFR-008 “obviousness”) or may they be icon-only with tooltip/`aria-label` as the plan states? [Conflict, Spec §NFR-008, Plan §Frontend UI]
- [ ] CHK006 Is matching `https://chat.forasoft.com` layout/chrome a UX requirement or only a feature reference (C-007), given the plan does not adopt a demo wireframe? [Conflict, Spec §C-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the 3-participant grid geometry specified, or is “for example 2×2” the only defined arrangement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §NFR-003, Spec §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK008 Is self-view placement and relative size specified for the alone-in-room state versus the multi-party state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-043, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the name-entry UI for an invite URL specified (full start screen vs in-route gate), including which primary action label is required? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §US-1, Plan §Frontend FSD]
- [ ] CHK010 Is «прогресс-индикатор» (FR-042) specified as determinate progress, indeterminate wait, or the copy «Подключение…» alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042, Spec §SC-015, contracts/realtime.md]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the room-full presentation specified (full page, dialog, or inline on the name gate) besides the mandated message and retry control? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 Is copy-link placement specified for all occupied-room states, or only for the alone hint (FR-043), while SC-012 still lists copy link as a required reachable control? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-043, Spec §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the device-access-denied message placement specified (banner vs toast vs tile) while the user remains in the room? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the autoplay fallback «Включить звук» specified as always shown, or only when the entry gesture did not unlock remote audio? [Clarity, Spec §FR-037, Spec §SC-010]

## Scenario & Edge Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Is a non-loading “media connecting” tile state specified as distinct from FR-034’s failed silhouette + message, so requirements do not collapse connecting into indefinite loading? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK016 Does FR-018 apply to the local self-view when the camera is off, absent, or denied, or only to remote tiles? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, Spec §US-7]
- [ ] CHK017 Are leave and mid-call server-error returns specified without a confirmation dialog (implicitly immediate), so tasks do not invent an extra UX step? [Coverage, Spec §FR-027, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK018 Is empty-chat presentation specified, or intentionally omitted so the input + auto-scroll rules are the only chat UX requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-023]

## Copy & Language

- [ ] CHK019 Are join/leave system-message strings specified in the spec, or is the plan’s gendered «присоединился(ась)» / «вышел(ла)» an unapproved invention relative to FR-025/FR-031 (which only forbid «соединение потеряно»)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-031, contracts/realtime.md]
- [ ] CHK020 Is `HH:MM` required as 24-hour clock for all locales, or may the viewer’s locale expand it (A-007)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §A-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the service-at-capacity Russian string in `contracts/realtime.md` the authoritative product copy, given FR-041/SC-014 require a clear message but the spec does not freeze the wording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-041, Spec §SC-014, contracts/realtime.md]

## Accessibility & Non-Functional

- [ ] CHK022 Are keyboard operation, visible focus, and contrast treated as product requirements (constitution XVI / plan WCAG 2.2 AA) or only as plan guidance, given the spec’s SC-012 measures reachability/legibility and not keyboard or contrast ratios? [Consistency, Spec §SC-012, Plan §Frontend UI]
- [ ] CHK023 Is “state not by color alone” specified for every media indicator (muted mic, no video, peer-media-failed), including the required non-color cue for the failed-tile case? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK024 Are accessible names required for icon-only controls in the spec itself, or only in the plan, and is that enough before tasking? [Gap, Plan §Frontend UI, Spec §SC-012]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- This run is **lite / author / UX**: items are limited to blocking ambiguities and conflicts; aesthetic polish and implementation verification are out of scope
- Resolving CHK003, CHK002, and CHK005 unblocks layout and control-bar tasks the most
